entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-22
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • `Extract local function` refactoring generates incorrect code for generic methods #81789
  • Completion should suggest potential generic parameter name when typing #81787

PullRequests

Created

  • Don't capture method type parameters when extracting a local function #81790
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Support using `string.Concat(ReadOnlySpan<string>)` for string lowering #81788
    Area-Compilers
  • Unsafe evolution: handle extern members #81786
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Don't assume misc files are documents #81785
    Area-IDE, VSCode

Merged

  • Make razor import lazy #81783
    Area-IDE, Next
  • Handle potential null in extension lookup (#80621) #81740
  • Use ArrayExpansion for fixed buffer fields #81536
    Area-Compilers, Community, Next
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #81779
    Area-Compilers, VSCode, Next

Updated

  • Support null-conditional operator when the return value is a pointer type (including function pointers) #80694
    Area-Compilers
  • Extension indexers: allow and resolve extension indexers #81607
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Indexers
  • Initial support for nullable analysis for Unions #81721
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions
  • Add SDK analyzer assembly redirector #80969
    Area-IDE
